title: Self inner product of a Walsh character
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S \subseteq [n]$. Then the Walsh--Fourier character $\chi_S(x) = \prod_{i \in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ satisfies
\[
  \langle \chi_S, \chi_S \rangle \;=\; \frac{1}{2^n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} \chi_S(x)^2 \;=\; 1,
\]
where the inner product is the uniform expectation of the pointwise product.
